_about: Madeline Brandeis's writing at Gutenberg: children of the World books for young readers. Every English text under the name at Gutenberg that no other shelf holds. Added 2026-10-22 at the coordinator's relay of Adam's keep-going message (Adam may veto).

_nonrenewal.mbrandeis-little-erik-of-sweden: PG 36333, Little Erik of Sweden (1938). Second check 2026-11-03 (non-renewal sweep; Adam 2026-11-03: "I want everything that was not renewed"): pipeline/renewal_check.py over NYPL's cce-renewals (every renewal 1950-1991, the records Stanford's database searches), surname plus title words: no renewal found. Lane D's Stanford search the same day found none either. Madeline Brandeis was an American writer and the book was published in the US, so URAA restoration does not reach it. US public domain by non-renewal; moved from _held.
